query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> AND script_hash IN ('4949403eece2eea554df601a883c50d0ef005fa66e7a7300bad5ebc2', '6d0b0ce6fc4336c208377ca85a99a7e18ad283a3b191b109befb9ab1', 'c935c937d0deda8975142c7b77aeef8f8cd48791e89a8ca7a0edc154')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
